build_cnn_model: build a CNN model for MNIST classification with two Conv2D and MaxPooling2D layers
load_mnist_data: load MNIST dataset and return preprocessed train and test sets with one-hot encoded labels
configure_dp_training: configure differential privacy training with DPKerasConfig specifying epsilon, delta, and clipping norm
make_model_private: make a Keras model private using keras_api.make_private with DP-SGD parameters
run_dp_mnist_training: run DP-SGD training on MNIST with compiled model and verify accuracy exceeds threshold
